entries.subject: HD 35296: a corona derived from its magnetic map
entries.finding: The potential field of each map to degree 15, with its source surface at 2.5 radii, reproduces the map with an rms residual of 1% to 1%. X-ray luminosity 2.7 × 10^29 erg/s (2RXS J052425.7+172300, 6.09 arcsec from the star's Gaia position, stellar probability 0.9998); temperature 5.6 million kelvin, not measured: the temperature stars of this X-ray output have (Johnstone & Güdel (2015), A&A 578, A129); mass loss 45 times the Sun's, not measured: what the X-ray output suggests (Wood et al. (2021), ApJ 915, 37), uncertain by a factor of 5 or more. The wind passes the speed of sound 1.23 radii out.
